source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 690 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 690 was established by Ordinance No. 25662, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 23, 2004. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 690 is established on property located north of Stevens Forest Drive and west of Mary Cliff Road. The size of PD 690 is approximately 25.5 acres. (Ord. Nos. 25662; 25892)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 690A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. Nos. 25662; 26105)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Except as provided in this section, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply.

(b) For a public school use in Subarea 1, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 690B). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R- 7.5(A) Single Family District, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to

development impact review (DIR) in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) In Subarea 1, a public elementary school other than an open enrollment charter school is permitted by right.

(c) In Subarea 3, the only use permitted is a private recreation center, club, or area by right. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District apply in this district.

(b) Side and rear yard. In Subarea 3, the minimum side or rear yard adjacent to Subarea 1 is 15 feet, and the minimum side or rear yard adjacent to Subarea 2 is 25 feet.

(c) Density. In Subarea 2, maximum number of dwelling units is 15.

(d) Floor area. In Subarea 3, maximum combined floor area for all structures is 1,000 square feet; and the maximum floor area for any one structure is 200 square feet.

(e) Height. For a public school use, maximum structure height is 35 feet. For all other uses, maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. For a public school use, maximum lot coverage is 20 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(g) Lot size. In Subarea 2, minimum lot size is 5,000 square feet. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use.

(b) Subarea 1. For a public school use, off-street parking is allowed in the required yards.

(c) Subarea 2. For a residential use, a minimum of two enclosed parking spaces must be provided.

(d) Subarea 3.

(1) Three off-street parking spaces are required.

(2) Off-street parking is allowed in the required yards. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Maintenance. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) Landscaping for a public school use in Subarea 1. Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(d) Tree mitigation for a public school use in Subarea 1.

(1) In addition to the alternative methods of compliance in Section 51A-10.109, “Alternative Methods of Compliance,” the Property owner may plant the replacement trees on other property within a five mile radius within the city that is developed or under development for a public school in the Dallas Independent School District. The location of replacement trees planted pursuant to this paragraph must be approved by the chief arborist prior to final inspection of a public school use in Subarea 1.

(2) A minimum of 11 site trees must be planted at 3033 Merrell Road before final inspection of F. P. Caillet Elementary School.

(3) A minimum of nine site trees must be planted at 2911 Northaven Road before final inspection of Herbert Marcus Elementary School.

(4) A minimum of 21 site trees must be planted at 6901 Military Parkway before final inspection of Urban Park Elementary School.

(5) A minimum of 57 site trees must be planted at 4001 Walnut Hill Lane before final inspection of Thomas Jefferson High School.

(6) A minimum of 13 site trees must be planted at 620 North St. Augustine Road before final inspection of William M. Anderson Elementary School.

(7) A minimum of three site trees must be planted at 6300 Elam Road before final inspection of Rufus C. Burleson Elementary School.

(8) Landscape plans for properties identified in Section 51P-690.111(e)(2), (3), (4).
(5), (6), and (7) must incorporate the tree mitigation requirements set forth in this subsection.

(9) For any property receiving replacement trees pursuant to this subsection, a landscape plan showing the location of the replacement trees must be approved by the chief arborist.

(10) All replacement trees must be planted within 24 months after issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a public school use in Subarea 1.

(e) Tree removal in Subarea 3. Trees, including protected and nonprotected trees, may not be removed except:

(1) to allow construction of structures for a private recreation center, club, or area;

(2) when required for utility construction within utility easements; or

(3) to allow placement of benches, lights, or paths. Paths may not exceed six feet in width. Lights may not exceed four feet in height.

(f) Tree mitigation in Subarea 3. Any trees located in that portion of Subarea 2, described in Exhibits A and B of Ordinance No. 26105, must be replaced at a 1:1 ratio using minimum two-inch caliper replacement trees in Subarea 3 within the timeframe described in Section 51A-10.134(5). (Ord. Nos. 25662; 26102; 26105)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.112. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) For a public school use in Subarea 1, signage may only be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 25662; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25662)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-690.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 690 is located on Zoning Map Nos. K-6 and L-6. (Ord. 25662)
